segments.text: ANd as Ieſus paſſed forth from thence, he ſawe a man (named Mathewe) ſitting at the receipt of cuſtome, and heſaid vnto him: folow me. And he aroſe and folowed him. And it came to paſſe as Ieſus ſate at meate in his houſe: beholde, many Publicans alſo and ſinners that came, ſate downe with Ieſus and his diſciples. And when the Phariſeis ſawe it, they ſaid vnto his diſciples: why eateth your Maiſter with Publicanes and ſinners? But when Ieſus heard that, he ſaied vnto them: They that be ſtrong nede not the phiſicion, but they that are ſicke. Goe ye rather and learne what that meaneth: I wil haue mercy, and not ſacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but ſynners to repentaunce.
